Any help will be brilliant,
RC

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Compare one SEM model to others
parts:
if the models are nested you can use the anova(object1, object2) function, this will do the respective chi-square difference test.

if the models are not nested you can use the vuongtest(object1, object2, nested = FALSE), from the nonnest2 package. This one will only with with estimator="ml". If you change the nested=T argument would work as a robust model comaprison for nested models
